about: Every third-party component compiled into EndfieldHUD.exe, EndfieldHUD-Setup.exe or uninstall.exe, or shipped in fonts/ or resources/. packaging/third_party_notices.cmake renders THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt from this list (installed next to EndfieldHUD.exe, in the setup and the portable zip); packaging_third_party_notices_contracts fails when a shipped component has no entry or its licence text is missing. 'paths' are the component's files in windows/ (every windows/third_party folder, bundled font and licence file must be covered); 'texts' are reproduced in full; 'macOriginal' is the Mac copy a text must equal when the repository root is present.
preamble: EndfieldHUD is an unofficial fan project by DDDuoDuo (https://github.com/DDDuoDuo/EndfieldHUD). Its original code is licensed under the MIT License. Each keeps its own licence, reproduced in full where it has one.

components.name: QuickJS-NG
components.use: JavaScript engine that runs the Merge! OrbiPom! scripts and Matter.js.

components.name: Microsoft Edge WebView2 SDK
components.license: BSD-3-Clause (Microsoft), with the SDK's third-party notices
components.use: WebView2.h and the static loader WebView2LoaderStatic.lib, for the account sign-in window. The SDK's licence is followed by its own third-party notices. The WebView2 Runtime itself is part of Windows and is not redistributed.

components.name: zlib
components.use: Decompresses EPUB archives and PDF streams in the E-Reader.

components.name: Noto Sans SC
components.use: The HUD's bundled text font, loaded privately (never installed into Windows).

components.name: Noto Sans KR
components.use: The HUD's bundled Korean text font, loaded privately (never installed into Windows).

components.name: Matter.js
components.use: Physics engine of the Merge! OrbiPom! minigame, run by QuickJS-NG.

components.name: Unity uGUI (Image geometry)
components.use: The HUD's image geometry rules (core/source_image_geometry.cpp) follow uGUI's Image.cs, through the macOS app's port.

components.name: C++/WinRT
components.version: the Windows SDK's projection headers (C++/WinRT 2.0.250303.1 in SDK 10.0.26100.0)
components.use: Header-only C++ language projection of the Windows Runtime APIs.

components.name: HarmonyOS Sans SC Medium (glyph subset)

components.attribution: HarmonyOS Sans is a typeface of Huawei Device Co., Ltd., used under Huawei's HarmonyOS Sans Fonts License Agreement. The glyph subset is unchanged game data taken from Arknights: Endfield; its ownership is unchanged.

components.name: ETOPO 2022 (NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information)
components.use: The Map's terrain, as a simplified derivative.
components.attribution: Terrain is a simplified derivative of NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. doi:10.25921/fd45-gt74 (CC0-1.0). The map is a decorative overview, not a navigation or survey map.
